version_policy: Core official runtime wheels remain exact. One observed optional-wheel incompatibility is explicitly overridden: supplied OpenTelemetry exporter1.44.0 conflicts with official Google ADK1.36.1's SDK<=1.41.1, so API/SDK/exporter are aligned to1.41.1 in both arms. All other official wheel versions constrain resolution. Complete dependency versions/URLs/hashes are frozen; installation is offline. This local compatibility repair is not proof of exact scorer deployment.

source_evidence.required_preseed: Yes. Current SDK still streams raw unpacked highest-version base wheels into site-packages and checks .swegemma_base_injected; stripped RECORD bypasses pip constraints. Reuse exact SDK layer, retain marker, then install separate compatibility layer. No SDK patch or test suppression.
source_evidence.cache_safety: Invocation-local tempfile root avoids the SDK fixed sp_base.tar cache crossing origins; selected wheel ZIPs and staged members are validated before the marker is trusted.
source_evidence.docker_comparison: Current public API filenames/sizes are observed by parent; parent downloads actual public bytes. Prepare hashes all seven fresh refs and compares each with copied-disk sources before use. Do not infer byte identity from matching names/sizes.
source_evidence.timeout_route_owner: CurrentPairedRunner owns reuse of real network=none timeout sink manager and host namespace /32 dummy route. Preparation neither substitutes tests nor opens a default route.

cpu_gate.selection: Fixed FastAPI6/Rich6 plan IDs; no Requests or HTTPX, no replacement on failure.
cpu_gate.pydantic1_required_skip: Report real required-test skip from unmodified collection/test output as conditionally ineligible, not resolved. No fake Pydantic1 fallback, test suppression, or grader changes.
cpu_gate.collection: Any collection failure or missing snapshot import provenance blocks GPU stage.
cpu_gate.pygments: Both 2.13.0 and 2.17.2 can be prebuilt; per-task images must be frozen from CPU evidence before model calls and identical in both arms. Default 2.13.0 is a historical compatibility choice, not proof of fresh-case eligibility.
cpu_gate.setup_mutations: Keep the actual current SDK setup/grading path unchanged. Capture its command outputs and JUnit; require snapshot import provenance and required-test execution. No custom restoration, test suppression, or grader bypass.
cpu_gate.resolution: Passing non-empty trusted salvage patches remain resolved after timeout; empty/untrusted patches never resolve. Owned by runner, not preparation.

availability.copied_disk: Not inspected by this worker. Inventory/prepare enumerate and hash resolved snapshot+patch, graph and embedding assets for all 129; missing assets fail with the complete recorded inventory. No reconstruction/eligibility claim before parent checks.

cost_time_risks: Supplied fresh official wheelhouse already totals 880842253 bytes (parent-observed). No bulk wheelhouse or giant competition archive redownload is performed.

Official vLLM wheel omits its Torch/CUDA dependency closure. Torch2.10 plus torchvision/torchaudio/NVIDIA runtime packages require additional multi-GB network and disk usage [INFERENCE]; freeze records actual final wheel byte totals/manifests rather than assuming those libraries are present.
Python3.12 interpreter and Linux x86_64 are required by cp312 official wheels. Missing binary dependencies fail freeze rather than compiling an unbounded source build.

Sandbox base pulling, apt installation, two compatibility image variants and hashing all129 assets add CPU wall time [INFERENCE]. All commands are timed in setup.log; no GPU is allocated during this phase.

Inherited SDK dynamic wheel injection and deliberately older task compatibility versions can expose real conditional-required skips or collection failures. Preserve those outputs and stop GPU rather than narrowing/replacing fixed cases.
CPU hosts may lack CUDA driver libraries despite a correctly installed CUDA wheel stack. Preflight real extension/model imports must report that limitation explicitly; it is not model-serving proof.
